messages:
mike: Quick proposal — add a lightweight "change_summary" index for console + exports so we can show diffs without pulling full resource snapshots. It'd be an event-level row with: actor, target, op, fields_changed[], small before/after diffs for changed fields (not whole resource). Questions: retention tiering, export cost model (NDJSON vs SQL dump), and whether we need to attach justification/ticket metadata when change is privileged.
sara: +1. Main problem today is console list view does one big fetch per row. summary index could be small and paginate fast. Concern: for nested blobs (policies) diffs might be noisy — we should normalize JSON paths.
liz: For exports we need to support "full snapshots" as an opt-in: some auditors want complete resource at time T. Could we store a snapshot only when change touches sensitive fields? Also need to ensure PII redaction options (mask emails/keys).
kevin: API shape debate: do we emit actor_id only (fast) and let UI resolve actor on-demand, or emit actor_display (email/name) inline (slower, duplicates, easier for offline exports). We already have actor_resolution cache in telemetry. Leaning toward emitting both: actor_id + actor_hint (email) — avoid flaky joins for exports.
mike: sample event shape idea:
```json
{
  "ts": "2912345678",
  "actor_id": "u_123",
  "actor_hint": "sara@redwood.ai",
  "action": "update-routing-policy",
  "target": "policy:p_987",
  "changed": ["priority","region_allowlist"],
  "delta_summary": {"priority":{"from":"low","to":"high"}}
}
```
liz: That looks fine. For export format we should support a "compact" NDJSON (only summary) and a "full" NDJSON (snapshots + blobs). Add a header line for schema version. Also: we need an export quota/cost cap — large full exports must be throttled and require opt-in with higher quota.
sara: UX question: in rollouts flow, can we show inline "who changed routing policy in last 24h" and link to the export? we should show inline count and top actor. small perf note: summary index needs to include "route_id" and "route_hash" to allow server-side grouping and counts without joins.
audit-bot: Export request 2912345689 queued (size_est=3.2GB). ETA ~2m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
kevin: One more ops note — retention tiers: 90 days for summary, 2 years for full snapshots (opt-in for enterprises). We should provide a config knob per-tenant + a legal hold flag.
mike: Agree. Next: I'll sketch an API for requesting exports + optional justification field and webhook callback. I'll post RFC draft later today.
